item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Freedom House rated Egypt's internet environment 28/100 (Not Free) for June 2022–May 2023 and reported severe constraints, including criminal penalties, harassment, surveillance, self-censorship, detention and abuse of online activists, while meaningful political opposition was described as virtually nonexistent under President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi.","notes":["The excerpt supports “virtually nonexistent,” not “negligible.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R01-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"During the coverage period, Mohamed Ali received a life sentence in absentia for online mobilization, Salma El-Shimy received a two-year prison sentence and fine for TikTok content, and authorities continued recycling detainees.
